title: Jiggly Korean Tinned Tomatoes Stew
description: A unique and adventurous stew originating from the Gyeongsang region of Korea. This bouncy-qq dish features tinned tomatoes and a Bain-marie cooking method, making it macrobiotic-friendly.
instructions: Combine the tinned tomatoes, bulgogi beef, 2 cloves of garlic, and 1 tablespoon of Gochujang in a large bowl.
Place the bowl over a Bain-marie and let it cook for 10 minutes.
Stir the mixture occasionally to prevent scorching.
Add 1 cup of Korean chili flakes and 1 cup of chopped green onions to the mixture and stir well.
Season the stew with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the stew to a serving dish and garnish with additional green onions if desired.
Serve the Jiggly Korean Tinned Tomatoes Stew hot over a bed of rice.
Alternatively, serve the stew with a side of kimchi for added flavor and nutrition.
For an extra kick, add a diced jalapeno pepper to the stew during the last minute of cooking.
Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and chopped scallions for added texture and flavor.
Serve the stew immediately and enjoy!
Consider serving the stew with a side of steamed vegetables or a simple green salad for added nutrition and variety.
